full_script: [cheerful] Diez frases con un hueco. Dilo antes de que se aclare. Yesterday I went to the beach. She made a cake for my birthday. We ate pizza last night. Ahora, nivel intermedio. He wrote me a letter. I left my keys at home. The kids fell asleep early. She dropped the glass and it broke. Y ahora, nivel experto. He held his breath underwater. The price rose by ten percent. She laid her coat on the bed. Si llegaste a la tres, eres nivel básico. Hasta la siete, intermedio. Y si sabías las diez, eres experto. [curious] ¿En cuál fallaste? Dímelo en los comentarios.
